notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
[b]It's finally here- Memories on the Shoreline has been released![/b]

Our newest otome visual novel is now available to everyone ❤️ Memories on the Shoreline is an otome dating sim featuring Melody, a med student, on her vacation of a lifetime where she meets two bachelors while at the beach. Brennan, the cheeky lady's man who's a bit overprotective, and Crylis, the fugitive merman who's hides behind a lot of snark. How exactly is she going to get herself out of this trouble—?!

It's been quite a few months since we came up with the idea for this and started drafting it and we're happy to finally release it to you guys. We hope you enjoy!
